verdict.rationale: Phoenix's docs describe the core workflow: group examples into datasets, rerun them through different versions of the app, and compare evaluation results to confirm whether a change improved performance. Experiments compare changes on the same inputs, and evals are described as helping you spot whether an update is an improvement or a regression and compare specific examples against prior runs. Dataset evaluators act as an automatic test harness, and datasets explicitly track prompt and LLM changes. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the side-by-side comparison UI or diff view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of regression comparison.
